documents.doc_pm: {"attrs": {"schemaVersion": 1}, "content": [{"attrs": {"blockId": "block-a0174427cd18bc4b", "level": 1}, "content": [{"text": "示例8 · 夏日游泳池开放通知", "type": "text"}], "type": "heading"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-952e20de6e04af52"}, "content": [{"text": "各位业主朋友们，小区游泳池将于7月15日起正式开放啦！", "type": "text"}, {"text": "本泳池设施完善、安全有保障。", "type": "text"}, {"text": "开放时间为每天上午9点至晚上9点。", "type": "text"}], "type": "paragraph"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-477b36941e238538"}, "content": [{"text": "办卡请联系物业管家王建国，电话13907215566，或到物业前台出示身份证办理（王女士上月已办理，流程很快）。", "type": "text"}], "type": "paragraph"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-2644743da3cc9361", "level": 2}, "content": [{"text": "温馨提示", "type": "text"}], "type": "heading"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-45287489405d7c75", "listStyle": "decimal", "start": 1}, "content": [{"attrs": {"blockId": "block-45287489405d7c75-item-1"}, "content": [{"attrs": {"blockId": "block-45287489405d7c75-item-1-p"}, "content": [{"text": "儿童需家长陪同。", "type": "text"}], "type": "paragraph"}], "type": "listItem"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-45287489405d7c75-item-2"}, "content": [{"attrs": {"blockId": "block-45287489405d7c75-item-2-p"}, "content": [{"text": "泳池每周三消毒，当天闭馆半天。", "type": "text"}], "type": "paragraph"}], "type": "listItem"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-45287489405d7c75-item-3"}, "content": [{"attrs": {"blockId": "block-45287489405d7c75-item-3-p"}, "content": [{"text": "酒后、患传染性疾病者禁止入池。", "type": "text"}], "type": "paragraph"}], "type": "listItem"}], "type": "orderedList"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-7f0c3ec33c35ba37"}, "content": [{"text": "希望大家", "type": "text"}, {"text": "度过一个清凉的夏天", "type": "text"}, {"text": "！", "type": "text"}], "type": "paragraph"}, {"attrs": {"blockId": "block-e0ee1a9fccad2a2b"}, "content": [{"text": "XX物业服务中心", "type": "text"}], "type": "paragraph"}], "type": "doc"}
